report.tagline: An app that buys, sells, finances and services used cars, so you can do the whole deal without trusting a stranger.
report.simpleSummary: Selling an old car in India usually means haggling with a local dealer and worrying about paperwork. Cars24 inspects your car, gives you a price, pays you and handles the RC transfer. On the other side, buyers can pick a checked car online, get a loan, and return it within a few days if they don't like it. Cars24 makes money on the gap between buying and selling price, plus loans, fees and services around owning a car.

overview.whatItDoes: Cars24 is a used-car company that sits between sellers and buyers and takes on the risk itself. It buys cars from people, fixes them, and sells them to retail buyers or dealers. It also gives car loans, insurance, warranties, challan payments and RC transfer help. The idea is that you trust the Cars24 brand instead of a stranger.
howItWorks: Seller enters car details and gets a price estimate in the app.
An inspector checks the car at home or at a branch, and Cars24 makes a final offer.
If the seller agrees, Cars24 pays and handles the RC transfer paperwork.
The car is either auctioned to dealers on the Cars24 dealer app, or repaired and listed for retail buyers.
Retail buyers browse cars with inspection reports, book a test drive, take a loan from Cars24 Financial Services, and get home delivery with a return window.
After purchase, owners use CarInfo and the Cars24 app for challans, insurance renewal and service.
overview.valueProposition: For sellers: a fair price, same-day money and no paperwork headache. For buyers: a checked car, a loan on the spot and the option to return it, which a local dealer rarely offers.

painPoints.pain: Sellers get lowballed by local dealers.

coreFeatures.feature: Instant price estimate and home inspection
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Gives a quote from car details and sends an inspector to check it.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: This is the top of the supply funnel. Getting good cars cheaply is where margin starts.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Lets thousands of dealers bid on inspected cars.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Moves cars fast and gives sellers a better price. It is now a commission business, which is lower risk.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Sells refurbished cars online with inspection reports, home test drives and returns.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Solves the trust problem for buyers and earns a higher margin than wholesale.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Approves car loans inside the purchase flow.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Most buyers need a loan. Lending is profitable and makes each sale more valuable.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Challan checks, RC details, insurance and service for any car owner.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Brings 3.8 crore monthly users who are future buyers and sellers, at low cost.

businessModel.summary: Cars24 makes money in four ways: the margin on cars it buys and resells, commission on dealer auctions, interest on car loans, and fees for ownership services like insurance, warranties and challans.

revenueStreams.detail: Buys a car, refurbishes it, sells it at a markup. Biggest revenue line (₹4,439 crore of product sales in FY26).
Since mid-FY26, earns a fee when dealers win auctions, instead of buying and reselling the car itself.
Cars24 Financial Services earns interest on loans. ₹299 crore turnover and ₹21 crore profit in FY26.
Insurance, warranties, RC transfer and challan services. Services revenue more than doubled to ₹206 crore in FY26.

businessModel.pricing: Car prices vary by car. Loans carry interest set per buyer. Service fees and commissions are not public.
costDrivers: Buying cars (₹4,256 crore in FY26, the largest cost)
Refurbishing, storage and holding cars that don't sell fast
Staff for inspection and sales (₹806 crore including large ESOP costs)
Marketing to get sellers and buyers
Loan losses when borrowers don't repay
businessModel.unitEconomics: Rough walk through one retail car: Cars24 buys a car for about ₹4.5 lakh and sells it for about ₹5 lakh. Out of the ₹50,000 gap, refurbishing, delivery, inspection and holding costs eat a big part, often ₹25,000 to ₹35,000. If the buyer also takes a loan and a warranty, Cars24 earns extra over the loan's life. So a car sold with a loan is worth much more than a car sold for cash. A car stuck in the yard for months loses value and can turn the deal into a loss. These are estimates.

growth.moat: Scale on both sides. Cars24 has years of price data on lakhs of cars, a large dealer network for auctions, its own lending licence and a big owner base through CarInfo. A new player would need all of these at once to price cars well and move them fast.

competitors.name: Spinny

competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Cars24 does both wholesale and retail and has lending and ownership services, while Spinny focuses on premium retail experience.

competitors.name: CarDekho / OLX Autos style classifieds
competitors.positioning: Listings where buyer and seller deal directly or via dealers.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Cars24 owns the transaction and the risk, which builds trust but costs more.

competitors.name: Maruti True Value and brand-certified programs
competitors.positioning: Carmaker-backed used cars with brand trust and service network.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Cars24 sells many brands and has a faster online flow, but lacks carmaker backing.

competitors.name: Local dealers

competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Cars24 offers inspection, loans and returns, while local dealers win on haggling and flexibility.

pmLessons: In high-price used goods, trust is the product. Inspection, returns and paperwork help are what people pay for.
Taking on stock risk builds trust but can burn cash. Cars24 moved wholesale to commission to cut that risk.
The add-ons (loans, insurance) can be more profitable than the main sale.
A free utility app like CarInfo can bring future customers at very low cost.
Revenue can fall while the business gets healthier. Look at net revenue and margins, not just top line.

interviewQuestions.question: Sellers complain the final price is lower than the online quote. How would you fix this?
interviewQuestions.hint: Split the problem: bad estimate model, or sellers hiding faults. Propose a range with reasons, photo-based pre-check, and track acceptance rate and complaints.

interviewQuestions.question: What should be Cars24's north star metric?
interviewQuestions.hint: Pick clean completed transactions. Explain why GMV alone is wrong, then break it into supply, conversion, attach rate and trust.

interviewQuestions.question: Should Cars24 hold inventory or be a pure marketplace?
interviewQuestions.hint: Compare trust and margin against cash and risk. Note the shift of wholesale to commission and suggest a mix by car type.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you grow Cars24 in tier-2 cities?
interviewQuestions.hint: Look at supply and demand separately. Use dealer partners, CarInfo users and local hubs. Watch loan defaults.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you measure if CarInfo is worth the acquisition?
interviewQuestions.hint: Track how many CarInfo users become sellers or buyers, cost per lead versus ads, and service revenue.
